text: A plane wave in vacuum has peak electric-field amplitude E₀. What is its time-averaged intensity (irradiance)?
explanation: Time-averaging the Poynting vector over one cycle gives I = ½ ε₀ c E₀² = E₀²/(2Z₀), with Z₀ ≈ 377 Ω. The factor of ½ comes from ⟨cos²(ωt)⟩ = ½; dropping it (choice 0) or using 2 or ¼ are exactly the factor-of-two power errors the text warns against.
